author: nanouai
title: Paperwork and deadlines
blurb: Official letters explained, deadlines tracked and replies drafted.
sample: The tax office wants one more document by the 15th. I've drafted the reply for you to check.
firstMessage: Look through my mail for official letters from the last 3 months (tax, social security, fines, property tax), explain each one in plain words, list the deadlines and remind me before each one.
